description: Call when the user asked for something telo cannot do with the tools here: a chart or layout on the telo home, a metric telo does not have, data that is missing, a question no tool answers. Pass their request in their words, what you tried instead, and what is missing. Then tell the user you noted it for the telo team, without promising it will be built. Not for questions you can answer by reading their data.

area.description: home: a chart, card or layout on the telo app; metric: a measure telo does not have; data: data missing or wrong; other

missing.description: What telo lacks, e.g. 'bars stacked by workout activity', 'blood glucose', 'sleep before 2023'

request.description: What the user asked for, in their words

tried.description: What you tried or offered instead, if anything

name: report_gap
title: Note something telo cannot do yet
